snippet.title: NOK - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the NOK Demo now on Steam! Wishlist NOK, it would really help us out! Each wishlist counts! :D
Link to NOK Demo's Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2526710/NOK_Demo/

Get ready to NOK! In this physics-based sandbox hidden object game, you step into a virtual world where you'll toss your worries aside and dive headfirst into the wild art of furniture flinging.

*Music by Edvard Grieg

#NOK #CozyGames #Cozy
#IndieGame #Gaming #NerdMonkeys #TheTipStudios #Demo #Release
